core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for local finite type (proof lines 1611-1616).

Choose a surjective \'etale chart U \to X; by the same locality lemma it suffices to show U \to Z is locally of finite type, and from f' locally of finite type plus Z' \times_Z U \'etale over Z' \times_Z X conclude Z' \times_Z U \to Z' is locally of finite type (proof lines 1618-1626).
Conclude U \to Z is locally of finite type by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma applied to the covering {Z' \to Z} (proof lines 1626-1629).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Move the property to the \'etale charts over Z and Z'.
Descend along the fpqc covering with the scheme-side lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof is the finite-type twin of the local-finite-presentation descent argument: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma for local finite type; the property is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z', the latter because Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and the fpqc descent lemma for schemes concludes. The double use of the locality lemma and the final descent are the substance.
